metrics.name: Calculation engine throughput (median)
metrics.workload: 10,000 deterministic synthetic shifts in 1,000 fortnightly pay periods (seed 20260706, generator v1)
metrics.methodology: Benchmark A: 3 warm-up + 10 measured repetitions, single process, forced GC before each repetition; isolated engine only (no HTTP/DB).
metrics.resumeSuitability: Suitable with the qualifier 'synthetic, isolated engine benchmark'.
metrics.environment: local-developer-workstation; 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13650HX; win32 10.0.26200; Node v24.22.1

metrics.name: Calculation runtime reduction vs recorded baseline (median total time)
metrics.workload: Same 10,000-shift workload, same machine and runtime for both runs
metrics.methodology: Benchmark F: (baseline - optimised) / baseline x 100 on median repetition time; output digests verified identical.
metrics.resumeSuitability: Suitable: measured before/after on identical workload with output equivalence verified.
metrics.environment: local-developer-workstation; 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13650HX; win32 10.0.26200; Node v24.22.1

metrics.name: Calculation throughput increase vs recorded baseline (median)
metrics.workload: Same 10,000-shift workload, same machine and runtime for both runs
metrics.methodology: Benchmark F: (optimised - baseline) / baseline x 100 on median shifts/second.
metrics.resumeSuitability: Suitable; prefer the runtime reduction figure (less prone to misreading).
metrics.environment: local-developer-workstation; 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13650HX; win32 10.0.26200; Node v24.22.1

metrics.name: Audit API throughput increase at 50 concurrent clients after query optimisation
metrics.workload: k6 closed model, 50 virtual users, no think time, 60 s measured after a 10 s warm-up; 30% dashboard, 25% history, 20% detail, 10% lines, 15% audit creation; production API image and PostgreSQL 17.6 on one workstation
metrics.methodology: Benchmark B, baseline versus optimised run with the same workload: (optimised - baseline) / baseline x 100 on requests per second.
metrics.resumeSuitability: Suitable with the qualifier 'local load test on a single workstation'.
metrics.environment: local-developer-workstation; 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13650HX; win32 10.0.26200; Node v24.22.1

metrics.name: Audit API p95 latency reduction at 50 concurrent clients
metrics.methodology: Benchmark B: (baseline p95 - optimised p95) / baseline p95 x 100, all request types together.
metrics.resumeSuitability: Suitable with the same qualifier; quote the absolute values alongside.
metrics.environment: local-developer-workstation; 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13650HX; win32 10.0.26200; Node v24.22.1

metrics.name: Audit API p95 latency at 50 concurrent clients (optimised)
metrics.workload: As above; saturated, so latency is mostly queueing in one Node.js process
metrics.methodology: Benchmark B, nearest-rank p95 over every request in the measured phase.
metrics.resumeSuitability: Context only: an absolute latency from one laptop is not a capacity claim.
